shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,80p' && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,160p'; printf '\\n--- Gravity theme API ---\\n'; rg \"ThemeProvider|theme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' | rg 'ThemeProvider|theme' | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- App.tsx ---'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- main.tsx ---'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- Theme types ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- Theme context ---'; rg \"ThemeContextProps|systemTheme|setTheme\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme -g '*.d.ts' -n"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- line refs ---\\n' && nl -ba src/App.tsx && nl -ba src/main.tsx"
